speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: One reason I asked the question is that I have a few residents who have asked about the impact of minors having tattoos early on, and the effect of them attending schools, because of specific regulations in schools if the tattoos are visible.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: My supplementary question is whether there will be plans to have laws to make sure that parental consent is needed for minors, especially those aged 14 and below.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Currently, for minors aged 14 and below, there is no need for parental consent for having tattoos.
